plugins.name: motion-launch-videos
plugins.description: Twelve skills for short launch and social videos made in code: kinetic type, flat shapes, cartoons, 3D type and logos, data charts, pixel art, particles, app UI, photo reels, captioned clips, transparent overlays and data globes. Each film is one self-contained HTML file driven by a pure seek(t), rendered at 1:1, 9:16 or 16:9 to MP4 with real motion blur, sound when needed and a verified seamless loop.
